reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V1 (per-segment yaw-rate bias) — bias_seg = mean(yaw_pred - yaw_meas) over straight-line samples (|delta_road|<0.01, >50 samples) per segment, subtracted from sim.csv's yaw_rate_pred_rads; this is the variant the agent explicitly ships ("V1 actually improved fidelity ... ship V1").
notes: V1 bias is segment-local (estimated per segment from straight-line samples), so it generalises trivially to held-out Ford platforms; the bias estimation uses all straight-line samples regardless of v_mps (agent's `straight` mask is delta-only), matching tools/variants.py. Baseline recomputation matches the precomputed canonical V0 to <1e-9 rad/s.
